pull_request.body: ## Summary Complete security remediation (Phases 1–3) plus vendored upstream compatibility fixes from open wylie102 PRs. ## Phase 1–3 (prior commits) - DuckDB preview hardening (`disabled_filesystems`, `-init /dev/null`) - Lambda syntax for DuckDB 1.5+ - `auto_install_extensions`, `cache_enabled` options - `SECURITY.md`, CI, smoke/CVE scripts ## Upstream vendoring (wylie102 open PRs) | Source | Change | |--------|--------| | [#33](https://github.com/wylie102/duckdb.yazi/pull/33) | `ya.emit("peek", { force = true })` on H/L scroll — fixes [#32](https://github.com/wylie102/duckdb.yazi/issues/32) | | [#22](https://github.com/wylie102/duckdb.yazi/pull/22) | `[[mgr.prepend_keymap]]`, `[mgr]` ratio section, `application/x-parquet` MIME matcher | Skipped (already superseded): #35, #30, #28, #24, #23, #19, #18 ## Test plan - [x] `./scripts/smoke-test.sh` passes locally - [x] CI green - [x] H/L column scroll repaints immediately on Yazi 26.x - [x] Parquet file without `.parquet` extension previews via MIME matcher

pull_request.title: feat: security hardening Phases 1-3 (DuckDB preview, CI, docs)

commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.message:
feat: Phase 1 security hardening for DuckDB previews

- Apply enable_external_access=false and disabled remote filesystems
  after extension load in run_query() preview spawns
- Replace deprecated DuckDB lambda arrow syntax with lambda c: form
- Document minimum DuckDB 1.4.2 and Yazi version requirements
- Update install instructions to ya pkg add stevencarpenter/duckdb
- Add Security section to README describing hardening and residual risks

Co-authored-by: Steven Carpenter <stevencarpenter@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.message:
feat: complete Phases 2-3 security hardening and CI

Phase 2:
- Skip ~/.duckdbrc on preview spawns via duckdb -init /dev/null
- Default auto_install_extensions to false; add load-only path
- Add cache_enabled option to skip parquet cache writes
- Nil-safe run_query, debug logging, and check_file_type fallbacks
- Add SECURITY.md with threat model and reporting policy
- Document extension pre-install, Yazi 26.x keymap syntax, new options

Phase 3:
- GitHub Actions: luacheck + DuckDB smoke tests
- scripts/smoke-test.sh and scripts/check-cve.sh maintenance tools
- Dependabot for GitHub Actions

Fix: remove enable_external_access=false (breaks local file preview in
DuckDB 1.4.2+); keep disabled_filesystems for remote FS only.

Co-authored-by: Steven Carpenter <stevencarpenter@users.noreply.github.com>
